description:
Search live availability and prices of directly-contracted hotels, apartments and villas.
        destination: city, area, region, hotel name or ISO country code (not needed on a hotel's own
        connector). Dates YYYY-MM-DD. adults and
        children_ages are per room. currency: EUR, USD… (if the property sells in it). board: Room only,
        Bed & breakfast, Half board, Full board or All inclusive. Returns hotels with options; each option has
        a rate_key (valid 30 minutes) for check_rate and book_hotel, and each hotel a booking_url (its official
        page with these dates) that the traveller can open to see prices and book.

board.description: Room only, Bed & breakfast, Half board, Full board or All inclusive.
board.title: Board

children_ages.description: Age of each child per room, e.g. [4, 9].
children_ages.title: Children Ages

currency.description: ISO currency code (EUR, USD…), used if the property sells in it.
currency.title: Currency

destination.description: City, area, region, hotel name or ISO country code. Leave empty on a hotel's own connector.
destination.title: Destination

max_total_price.description: Maximum total price for the whole stay, in the requested currency.
max_total_price.title: Max Total Price

rooms.description: Number of rooms with the same occupancy.
rooms.title: Rooms

title: Search hotels
